puzzles.name: Entrance Boulder
puzzles.description: Blow up the large boulder blocking the cavern entrance with a Bomb Flower.
hints: Bomb Flower grows right next to boulder
Goron outside says: "Smash it with a Bomb Flower!"

puzzles.name: Armadillo Statue Puzzle
puzzles.description: Push Armadillo statues onto pressure plates to open doors. Requires Goron Bracelet for heavy statues.
hints: Statues have flat backs for pushing

puzzles.name: Bomb Flower Throwing Platform
puzzles.description: Stand on platform, throw Bomb Flowers at distant switches to open doors across gaps.
steps: Pick up Bomb Flower on platform

puzzles.name: Dodongo Skull Eyes
puzzles.description: Shoot the eyes of the giant Dodongo skull with arrows to open its mouth (main progression path).
steps: Skull mouth opens - path to B2

puzzles.name: Lava Bridge Timing
puzzles.description: Hit crystal switch to extend/retract bridge over lava. Timing required to cross.

puzzles.name: Bomb Bag Chest Puzzle
puzzles.description: Push block to reach chest containing Bomb Bag on elevated platform.

phases.name: Rolling Charge
phases.mechanic: King Dodongo rolls around arena, breathing fire
phases.puzzle: Throw Bomb Flower/Bomb into mouth when he inhales
phases.vulnerability: Mouth opens wide, glows orange before fire breath

phases.name: Stunned Recovery
phases.mechanic: After bomb ingestion, King Dodongo is stunned on ground
phases.puzzle: Attack tail weak point with sword
phases.vulnerability: Tail flashes red, take 3-4 hits per stun

phases.name: Enraged Fire Rain
phases.mechanic: Low health - jumps to center, rains fire bombs from sky
phases.puzzle: Dodge fire bombs, wait for inhale, bomb mouth again
phases.vulnerability: Same mouth bomb, but faster inhale cycle
